listeners.doc: Webhook listener that dispatches each inbound Google Chat interaction event to the attached service.

serviceTypes.doc: Receives Google Chat app interaction events: messages, space membership changes, card clicks, widget updates, commands, and form submissions.

options.name: onMessage
options.doc: Invoked when a user sends a message to the app, @mentions it in a space, or invokes a slash command routed as a message.

params.name: event
params.doc: The Chat interaction event. Declare MessageEvent instead of ChatEvent for compile-time assurance that message is present, avoiding nil-check operators on access.

params.name: caller
params.doc: Caller for responding synchronously via respond(), and for async follow-up Chat API calls (sendMessage, updateMessage, deleteMessage, getSpace), pre-configured with the event's space context.

options.name: onAddedToSpace
options.doc: Invoked when the Chat app is added to a space (a room, group chat, or direct message).

params.name: caller
params.doc: Caller for responding synchronously via respond(), and for async follow-up Chat API calls (sendMessage, updateMessage, deleteMessage, getSpace), pre-configured with the event's space context.

options.name: onRemovedFromSpace
options.doc: Invoked when the Chat app is removed from a space. There is no caller for this event, the app cannot send a response since it has already been removed.

options.name: onCardClicked
options.doc: Invoked when a user clicks a button or other interactive element on a message card or an app-home card.

params.name: caller
params.doc: Caller for responding with a Message (dialogs, card updates, link previews) or a Card (app-home interactions, auto-wrapped for navigation), pre-configured with the event's space context. Also exposes async follow-up Chat API calls (sendMessage, updateMessage, deleteMessage, getSpace).

options.name: onWidgetUpdated
options.doc: Invoked when a widget, such as a text input, requests autocomplete suggestions or another update while the user is still interacting with it.

params.name: caller
params.doc: Caller for responding synchronously with the widget update result, typically autocomplete suggestions.

options.name: onAppCommand
options.doc: Invoked when a user invokes a Chat app command (a slash command or a quick command).

params.name: caller
params.doc: Caller for responding synchronously via respond(), and for async follow-up Chat API calls (sendMessage, updateMessage, deleteMessage, getSpace), pre-configured with the event's space context.

options.name: onAppHome
options.doc: Invoked when a user opens the app's home page tab.

params.name: caller
params.doc: Caller for responding with the Card to display. It is automatically wrapped in the RenderActions/pushCard structure the app-home tab expects.

options.name: onSubmitForm
options.doc: Invoked when a user submits a dialog or a form from the app home.

params.name: caller
params.doc: Caller for responding with the updated Card for the app home. It is automatically wrapped in the RenderActions/updateCard structure the app-home tab expects.

rules.message: A ChatService must declare at least one event handler, otherwise Google Chat interaction events are received and silently dropped.
